text.en: Many women were honored,
yet you exceeded them all,
for you are the pride of virgins,
O Mary the Mother of God.
Intercede on our behalf,
O Lady of us all, the Theotokos, Mary,
the mother of our Savoir,
that He may forgive us our sins.
Pray to the Lord on our behalf,
O beholder of God the Evangelist, Abba Mark the Apostle,
text.ar: يا ناظر الإله الانجيلي مرقس الرسول،

text.en: that He may forgive us our sins.

text.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ:
text.cop_lat: Je efesmarowot enje Efiot nem Epsheeri:
text.en: Blessed be the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit,
text.ar: لأنه مبارك الآب و الابن و الروح القدس،

text.cop: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ:
text.cop_lat: nem Pi-epnevma ethowab ti-etrias etjeek evol:
text.en: the perfect trinity.
We worship Him and glorify Him.
All the kings of the earth,

section.en: Gospel Response - Matins, Ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ

text.en: wake into your light,
and the Gentiles in your light rays,

the mother of our Savoir,
that He may forgive us our sins.

We exalt you worthily,

section.en: Gospel Response - Liturgy, Ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁ

Blessed are you among women,
and blessed is the fruit of your womb.

the mother of our Savoir,
that He may forgive us our sins.
